'''Rinagom''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

==Description==
Located at the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Rimward]] fringe of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], Rinagom was an isolated [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]], with a main continent holding tens of thousands of acres of [[Farm/Legends|farmland]]. Produce from this area was delivered to foodstuff refineries and packaging plants on the planet's coastal regions.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />

==History==
Wholly owned by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], Rinagom was a major agricultural producer for CSA operations in its Rimward region of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. [[Viceroy]] [[Cray Linlok]] served as the CSA's local lead [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], and took full advantage of the planet to abuse employees and indentured servants to maximize production.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
